latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of UX Research Interview Kit.

- Create structured, lightweight user interview plans from product questions.
- Generates neutral interview scripts, note templates, bias checks, and synthesis grids.
- Includes guidance for research objectives, screener questions, and recruiting criteria.
- Provides quality and bias checklists and decision-ready synthesis tools.
- Supports founders, product managers, and designers; not for regulated or statistically valid research.
